scientific_integrity: Uniform labelled connected simple unicyclic graphs; conditional on exactly r>=1 leaves, fixed r for the limit. The exact forest count and uniform polynomial asymptotics supply the proof; computation only crosschecks finite orders.
scientific_limitations: No statement for an unicyclic component selected from a binomial random graph
Janson 2003 complete text not accessible, and priority is provisional
title: A beta-square cycle-length law for unicyclic graphs with a fixed number of leaves
